title: Enterprise Connectivity: accepted-source pricing qualifying scope
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following eligibility and object boundaries for accepted-source pricing.

## Scope clause 17
For accepted-source pricing, this assisted route applies only to the uniquely identified unbilled source bundle whose interval tier matches the current holding tier and whose contract is on-demand with no approved negotiated rate.

## Scope clause 18
For accepted-source pricing, its latest invoice assessment names that source bundle explicitly.

## Scope clause 19
For accepted-source pricing, this invoice route requires selected export bundle to be the sole posted primary internet outbound transfer meter for its holding and UTC month, representing the entire month with the holding active throughout it; the full monthly allowance therefore belongs to that source.

## Scope clause 20
For accepted-source pricing, its tier, commercial attributes, US East region and approved tax treatment must match the unchanged current holding attributes.

## Scope clause 21
For accepted-source pricing, other monthly sources retain ordinary chronological allocation and are outside this assisted route.

## Scope clause 22
For accepted-source pricing, these replacements apply only within the completed single-source assisted invoice route just defined; ordinary portfolio aggregation, eligibility and price priority remain unchanged outside that route.
